title: Indie First Week
description: Indie First Week is the first curated ThemeShot series on GuessTheGame.net: independently published games, gameplay-first screenshots, and a spoiler-free landing page. Use this week to learn the daily rhythm — six shots, six guesses — without extra modes or answer dumps.

title: Autumn Showcase
description: Autumn Showcase is a September ThemeShot week about reading a scene, not a logo. Each UTC day adds one curated screenshot puzzle; this page lists only dates that have already published. Titles, covers, and solutions stay off the theme page so you can still play fair.

title: Hearth & Harvest
description: Hearth & Harvest is a mid-autumn ThemeShot window about everyday systems: kitchens, workshops, towns you tend, and the quiet loop of making a place livable. Read the room, not a logo. Dates appear only after they publish. Titles stay off this page so you can still play fair.

title: Labyrinth Logic
description: Labyrinth Logic asks you to study machines, rooms, and spatial jokes. Each UTC day is one curated still from a clever world — not a cover, not a title card. This page lists only dates that have already opened. Solutions never appear here.

title: Far Roads
description: Far Roads is a longer ThemeShot stretch about leaving camp and reading a landscape. Watch weather, paths, and how a world is framed in motion. Published dates only; no covers, no answer dumps, no spoiler SEO.
